interventions.name: Seed a species
interventions.help: Adds 5 population points of the chosen species. Brings back lost species; without good conditions the seeded species will die again.

interventions.name: Thin a species
interventions.help: Leaves 10% of the species' population. Lets light through to lower plants and reduces fuel for wildfires.

story.applied: The player thins out {species}: a tenth remains.

interventions.name: Orbital mirrors
interventions.help: For 500 ticks raises the temperature the climate settles toward (light, moderate or full power). Light often helps, strong is a risk.

story.applied: The player unfolds orbital mirrors ({level_name}): the planet receives more light.

interventions.name: Orbital dust
interventions.help: For 500 ticks lowers the temperature the climate settles toward (light, moderate or full power). Strong cooling can trigger an ice age.

story.applied: The player scatters dust in orbit ({level_name}): the planet receives less light.

interventions.name: Cloud seeding
interventions.help: For 300 ticks rain falls even from thin clouds. Good for shrubs and trees, but dries the air that moss and algae live on.

story.applied: The player seeds the clouds: rain falls even from thin clouds.

interventions.name: Aquifers
interventions.help: For 300 ticks the land evaporates 2.5 times more: humidity and rainfall rise. A good answer to drought.

story.applied: The player releases the aquifers: the land evaporates again.

interventions.name: Awaken volcanoes
interventions.help: For 400 ticks volcanoes release 3 times more CO₂: food for plants and long-lasting warming.

story.applied: The player awakens the volcanoes: CO₂ pours into the atmosphere.
